theorems.statement: ∀ {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (q : Nat.Primes) (S : Subgroup (ExtCitation.primeLocalGaloisGroup q)) (U : Subgroup S) (M : Rep.{0} (ZMod p) S) [FiniteDimensional (ZMod p) M], (∃ F₀ : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ), FiniteDimensional ℚ F₀ ∧ F₀.fixingSubgroup.comap ((ExtCitation.primeLocalToGlobal q).comp S.subtype) ≤ U) → (∀ m : M, ∃ F : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ), FiniteDimensional ℚ F ∧ ∀ s : S, ((ExtCitation.primeLocalToGlobal q).comp S.subtype) s ∈ F.fixingSubgroup → M.ρ s m = m) → ∃ E : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ), FiniteDimensional ℚ E ∧ Normal ℚ E ∧ E.fixingSubgroup.comap ((ExtCitation.primeLocalToGlobal q).comp S.subtype) ≤ U ∧ (∀ s : S, ((ExtCitation.primeLocalToGlobal q).comp S.subtype) s ∈ E.fixingSubgroup → (∀ m : M, M.ρ s m = m) ∧ (∀ d : M.dualTwist (((ExtCitation.cycloChar p).comp (ExtCitation.primeLocalToGlobal q)).comp S.subtype), (M.dualTwist (((ExtCitation.cycloChar p).comp (ExtCitation.primeLocalToGlobal q)).comp S.subtype)).ρ s d = d) ∧ (∀ a : Rep.res S.subtype (groupCohomology.ofChar (k := ZMod p) ((ExtCitation.cycloChar p).comp (ExtCitation.primeLocalToGlobal q))), (Rep.res S.subtype (groupCohomology.ofChar (k := ZMod p) ((ExtCitation.cycloChar p).comp (ExtCitation.primeLocalToGlobal q)))).ρ s a = a))
